article.title: As criticism grows over landslide inaction, leaks show Nepal’s new leaders groomed by U.S. regime change outfit
article.author: Kit Klarenberg
article.content: As public anger against the Nepalese government mounts after deadly landslides in Nepal, files show the country’s new prime minister and several of his colleagues came to power thanks in part to a covert program sponsored by the U.S. government. The post As criticism grows over landslide inaction, leaks show Nepal’s new leaders groomed by U.S. regime change outfit appeared first on MR Online .
